extracted.name: 90 Seconds Mug Brownie
extracted.description: The weather is snowy, and I got the sudden craving for a gooey chocolate brownie. I just didn’t have the patience to make a whole big batch so I made a mug brownie- just enough to satisfy my chocolate craving!
ingredient_lines: 1 tablespoon milk or a little more if needed
instruction_lines: Add all ingredients to a microwave-safe mug with dry ingredients first and then the wet ingredients- hold the walnuts and the chocolate chips.
Mix well with a spoon until smooth. Now add the walnuts and the chocolate chips and stir once gently.
Microwave for 60 seconds, then another 15 seconds, and if needed, another 15 seconds. Enjoy warm!
